{{Top|leg}}
'''Fink's Hole''' was a burrough on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shador]], close to [[Mud Station]]. Like all burroughs, Fink's Hole was built on support pylons that raised the buildings out of the world's swampy surface. [[Zeboron Delta]] and [[Zeboron Gamma]] were located in Fink's Hole.
